agent_protocol: Fresh Codex subagent for each arm, fork_turns=none, inherited session model and effort; no model override. Only task, API operating guide and connection supplied.
model_id: not exposed by collaboration tool; inherited session default
comparison_limit: Different model/agent protocol from run eight. No comparable model-token or cost metrics.
replay_scope: Successful project commands only; read-only FEFF calculations and fits are captured in evidence.jsonl but not rerun by transcript replay.
source_rejections: Retained in replay run files for original transcript-dependent grades.
isolation: Each arm has its own backend and data root, loopback ephemeral port, fresh example project. No shared FEFF cache.
evidence: HTTP request bodies and replies without headers; only requests between started and finished timestamps; no project arrays unless requested by the arm.
metric_timing: started.json written by arm before API use; finish stamped when coordinator detects answer.md, before snapshots and verification.
